target_customer: Title agencies and processors; homeowners preparing to sell or refinance as a direct buyer of the score
problem: Title processing is manual back-office work, and lenders taking on title risk as title insurance becomes optional on refinances lack a standard property risk assessment.
business_model: Software for title agencies plus a $200 per property Vestris Score sold to homeowners
product_category: AI title processing and property title risk scoring

founders.name: Joshua Tang
prior_employers: MRacing, University of Michigan Formula SAE team (telemetry software)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked a summer at a title desk.

founders.name: Aahil Valliani
previous_startups: Safe Kids AI (K-12 mental health software, 10,000+ users)
founders.background_notes: YC page says three USPTO patents and a summer closing files at a title shop; education inferred only from the page calling them UMich roommates.

competitors.name: Doma
competitors.what: Machine learning title and escrow automation, first vendor in Fannie Mae's title waiver pilot
competitors.traction_then: Pilot started November 2024; Doma later acquired by Title Resources Group

competitors.name: First American AgentNet Assist
competitors.what: AI tool to analyze title documents and speed closings
competitors.traction_then: Launched April 2026 by the largest incumbent underwriter

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting liens, taxes and easements from county records and scoring them needs document parsing and public record coverage, with fragmented county data the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbents hold deep historical title data that startups lack, and the software layer can be copied; regulatory dependence adds uncertainty.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: First American launched title AI tools in 2026; no acquisition of Vestris found.

market_need_then: The FHFA and Fannie Mae title waiver pilot, expanded in 2025 with a second vendor, moves title risk to lenders, which the company cites as its opening. Title insurers oppose the program, so the policy outcome is uncertain.

branding.domain_note: Uses vestris.ai with a score subdomain; no .com acquisition found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, warm, closing line 'Built with care.'

branding.brand_signature: The FICO score for homes positioning

brand_strength.rationale: A clear one-line positioning, but no press found about the brand and the name resembles Vestis and Vestian.

outcome_analysis: Vestris is an active Summer 2026 company with no exit and no confirmed funding. A regulatory shift toward optional title insurance on refinances is a tailwind and the founders have title shop exposure, but incumbent data advantages and policy uncertainty make the path unproven.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with Y Combinator only; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded. Education for Aahil Valliani is only implied by the YC page and the first founder's education was stated directly. One third-party page says it reconstructs applications, so founder names rely on the YC page. Location conflict between San Francisco (YC) and DC area (another source).
